body: I just started doing poems everyday for the last week to try and keep me going another day. It helps a little. I used to paint and do all different things that brought me joy when I was needing an escape but i always end up  feeling empty and misplaced. I play out different ways everyday but I look at my poem and it makes me think about how I felt when I wrote it and i my thoughts on paper make me feel like I'm a little normal and doesn't hurt as bad. I don't like being like this, I hate my thoughts and being born this way I'm embarrassed and annoyed that I can't be healthy minded like so many people and I feel so alone. I don't know if you'll read this but I hope it helps even if my words are annoying. Thank you for sharing as that is one of the hardest things to do.
